newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares make slight gain in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares make slight gain in thin trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares rose slightly on Wednesday, with Hermis Bank, Lithuanian Gas and Birzai Milk again among the most actively traded.
But overall business was fairly low at 572,967 litas on the central market as the group A index of the most actively traded stocks rose 4.88 points to 1,852.6.
Bloc trading came to 306,356 litas with leading bank Vilnius Bank turning over 211,650 litas. The secondary T-bill market turned over 400,608 litas.
Lithuanian Gas turned over 197,021 litas as it stayed unchanged at 1.55 litas.
Birzai traded 113,056 litas but dropped to eight litas from 8.1. Key commercial bank Hermis Bank turned over 101,000 litas and ended unchanged at 200 litas.
